subject: Web Development
title: JavaScript and AI
description: A quick, practical guide to JavaScript and AI.

hook.text: Python dominates AI, but JavaScript is quietly becoming a serious contender.

buildup.text: TensorFlow.js runs machine learning models directly in the browser, no server needed.

discovery.text: Web apps can now classify images, recognize speech, and generate text on the client side.

twist.text: WebGPU gives JavaScript access to GPU computing power that was once Python's advantage.

climax.text: The browser is becoming an AI platform, and JavaScript is its default language.

punchline.text: AI is coming to JavaScript, not just Python.
